title: Direct and Indirect Speech: Wishes and Desires — Quiz 143
content:
## Direct and Indirect Speech: Wishes and Desires

Practise reporting wishes with may and long live.

### Lesson focus

1. The hermit said to her, “May God bless you with a son!”
2. The villagers said, “Long live the brave young lady!”
3. Mother said, “May you pass the exam!”

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
